description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans membership table operations using Apache Cassandra as the storage provider. It tests functionality such as reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up membership entries, as well as verifying TTL behavior and integration with gateway providers.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringTableTests
classes.description: Contains comprehensive unit tests for the Cassandra-based Orleans membership clustering table, verifying core operations and TTL behavior.
